citations.assessment: The exact objection is one side earlier in the retrieved witness. Rabbi Acha Arikha is expressly identified as Rabbi Acha bar Pappa and objects to Rabbi Abba.
One version has Acha transmitting from Abba, who transmits from Adda. Other versions have Abba first.
Explicitly identifies Arikha as Acha bar Pappa and records his objection to Rabbi Abbahu.
The cited exposition later in the entry has Acha bar Avun bar Binyamin reporting Acha son of Rav Pappi. Vayikra Rabbah differently divides the names and gives another source for the saying.
Acha bar Pappa questions Rabbi Immi about the valuation of an animal and land brought to the marriage.

citations.assessment: One attribution makes Rabbi Acha Arikha the transmitter of Rav Huna’s ruling.
Acha Arikha offers an explanation to Rabbi Zeira in the homily about the seal and Jehoiachin.
The parallel has a dialogue in which Acha Arikha offers Zeira an interpretation and Zeira confirms and completes it. The twice wording may count differently or report another witness.
Rav Acha Arikha explicitly recites before Rav Chinena.
In the third of the three stated alternatives Acha transmits from Chanina bar Pappa.

holds.reason: The distinct recitation before Rav Huna remains unlocated, as Heilprin records.
